item.title: Serif bosy fonts that work well with Landmark?
item.description: Im working with Landmark family fonts [http://www.typography.com/fonts/landmark/overview/] as my title font, looking for subtitle and Main body ‘modernist’ font that works with Landmark’s appeal. I feel a serif family would work well but can figure which?
